BaseCsvDAO

class BaseCsvDAO[source]

Bases: DAO[T]

CRUD of a model stored in one CSV file per player.

Attributes:
modeltype, class attribute

Model dataclass (with PROPERTIES and get_data()). Defined by the subclass.

suffixstr, class attribute

File name suffix, e.g. “kartea_session”. Defined by the subclass.

single_rowbool, class attribute

True when the file has a single row per player (the key is the player id, e.g. configuration). False (default): one row per record, with an incremental id (sessions, details).

csv_handlerCSVHandler

Reads/writes in the T-TEA format (;, UTF-8 with BOM).

cachedict[int, T]

Loaded objects, by key (record id or player id).

file_mapdict[int, str]

Player id -> path of the player’s file.

next_idint

Next free id (used only when single_row is False).

int_propertieslist[str]

Fields annotated as int, converted from text on load.

float_propertieslist[str]

Fields annotated as float, converted from text on load.

bool_propertieslist[str]

Fields annotated as bool, converted from text on load.

Notes

Subclasses must define model and suffix (and single_row when needed) and implement _deserialize(row, player_id), which builds the object from a CSV row (None = skip the row). They may override _player(obj) (owner of the object, which defines the file; default obj.player) and _is_valid(obj).

Creating the DAO loads all the files of its suffix into the cache (load_all).

Methods

delete

Remove the record; delete the file if it becomes empty.

get_filename

Return the file path of the player who owns obj.

Write a new record and return its key.

list

Return all records in the cache.

load_all

Load the *_*_{suffix}.csv files into the cache.

Return the player name made safe for a file name.

select

Return the record with the given key, from the cache.

update

Rewrite the object's row (and the file name).
static sanitize_filename(name)[source]

Return the player name made safe for a file name.

Parameters:
namestr

Player name.

Returns:
str

The name stripped and lowercased, with every character that is not a letter, digit, _ or - replaced by _.

Examples

>>> BaseCsvDAO.sanitize_filename(" André Avô ")
'andré_avô'
get_filename(obj)[source]

Return the file path of the player who owns obj.

Parameters:
objT

Model object.

Returns:
str

KARTEA_PLAYER_DIR/{player_id}_{sanitized_name}_{suffix}.csv.

load_all()[source]

Load the *_*_{suffix}.csv files into the cache.

Notes

  • Ensures the KarTEA folders exist first.

  • The player id is the number before the first _ of the file name; files without it are skipped.

  • Rows for which _deserialize returns None are skipped.

  • With incremental ids, next_id becomes the highest key + 1.

insert(obj)[source]

Write a new record and return its key.

Parameters:
objT

Object to insert. With incremental ids, obj.id is overwritten with next_id.

Returns:
int | bool | None

The key of the record, or False if the object is invalid.

Notes

Records with incremental ids are appended to the end of the file; in single_row mode the file is (re)created with the row.

update(obj)[source]

Rewrite the object’s row (and the file name).

Parameters:
objT

Object with the new data.

Returns:
bool

True if updated; False if the object is invalid or its key is not in the cache.

Notes

If the player’s name changed, the file is renamed to the new sanitized name. If no row has the object’s key, the row is appended.

delete(obj_id)[source]

Remove the record; delete the file if it becomes empty.

Parameters:
obj_idint

Key of the record.

Returns:
bool

True if removed from the file; False if the key is unknown or the player has no file.

Notes

The record is removed from the cache even when the player has no file mapped (in that case False is returned).
